Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Roger 2-Pack Mid-Century 2-Tone Accent Chairs, 34.8"H, Navy and Grey
Colors: Gray (Seat)
Materials: Polyester
Two-tone upholstery adds a modern flair to a classic mid-century design. Light padding on grey seats and curved navy backs add comfort to pieces that can multi-task at your dining room table, as extra seating in a living room, or as desk chairs. 19.3"W x 23.4"D x 34.8"H. Seat height is 19.1". Polyester fabric on wood frame; metal legs with black finish A multi-tasking chair easily moved from room to room; durable finish on legs. Assemble in 10 minutes or less. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
